Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if this Digimon is suspended, it gets +4000 DP until your opponent's turn ends.
Inherited Effect: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
